title: Spend ledger line
description: One line of ledger.jsonl, the append-only record of money reserved and spent per provider. It has no version field. A reservation counts at its reserved amount until a settle (the actual cost) or gap (usage unknown, so the reservation stands) line with the same id ends it. Lines with an event are written with a date and a model, which the reader does not use. The oldest files hold lines with only a provider and an amount, still read. Unknown fields are rejected.

owner.description: Absent in ledgers written before spend was attributed to runs, read as empty.
